geometry: Central intricate clockwork gear mechanism with a core navigational star; set within a heavy stone frame with runic carvings
color_palette: Deep amber and molten orange; metallic gold and bronze for the gears; dark basalt stone for the border
symbolism: The gears and compass signify industrial precision, technological progress, and the mastery of space-time navigation
cultural_hints: A technocratic society that prizes engineering, precision, and the mechanical laws of the universe above all else
distinctive_traits: The central core glows with a heat-like intensity, and the background nebula mimics the appearance of a forge's fire
